children: China umbrella and electronics maker's H1 revenue fell 30% yr/yr on weaker umbrella demand
Net loss widened to RMB19.7 mln, driven by lower sales and higher share-based payment costs
No interim dividend declared for the period
Company did not provide specific financial guidance or outlook for future periods
UMBRELLA DEMAND DECLINE – Revenue fell 30.1% to RMB121.3 mln as poor market conditions reduced demand for nylon and POE umbrellas
SHARE-BASED PAYMENTS – Administrative expenses rose to RMB22.2 mln from RMB18.2 mln, mainly due to RMB2.8 mln in share-based payment expenses
NEW ELECTRONICS SEGMENT - Co said computer-related electronic products and services contributed RMB3.4 mln in first-half revenue
